Then he asked, “When will the Day of Qiyamah come?” The Prophet ﷺ said, “The one who answers does not know more about it than the one who asks. That is, I do not know more about it than you.” He said, “Then at least inform me of its signs.” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “(One of its signs is that) a slave woman will give birth to her mistress. (The second sign is that) utterly poor people, without clothes and without sandals, who used to herd goats, will compete with one another in raising huge buildings.” Hazrat Umar (RA) says, “After this the man went away. I remained silent for a while. (I did not ask anything about the one who had come.) Then Rasulullah ﷺ asked, “O Umar! Do you know who the questioner was?” I said, 'Allah and His Rasul know best.' Rasulullah ﷺ said, “That was Jibra'il; he came to you to teach you your Deen.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- Regarding what is stated in the Hadith, “A slave woman will give birth to her mistress,” one explanation has also been given: as the Last Day draws near, disobedience to parents will become very commonplace. Leaving aside that even daughters, who by nature are inclined to obey their mothers, will disobey their mothers, daughters will dominate their mothers just as a mistress exercises authority over her slave woman.
